json.description: Stable local contract for text-to-PCM16LE streaming, health, full-duplex input, ASR capability reporting, and barge-in cancellation. TTS is paper-derived; ASR/dialogue/transport are local glue.

process.stop: SIGTERM or KeyboardInterrupt; bounded verification always stops the process

env.BITVOICE_ASR_COMMAND: JSON argv array or argv text for CommandASR; shell=False
env.BITVOICE_ASR_MODEL: informational local model path; no secrets
env.BITVOICE_LIBRITTSR: optional external LibriTTS-R/MFA data root; not bundled

asr.reason: No offline ASR model is bundled; use the text control channel.

textSynthesis.note: There is no POST/HTTP synthesis endpoint. Use WebSocket /ws text frames or the CLI demo.

websocket.framing: RFC 6455; client frames masked; server text frames JSON; server audio frames are binary opcode 0x2

baseFields.session_id: string; opaque session identifier; omitted uses server-assigned id
baseFields.generation: integer; monotonic turn generation on event frames

serverToClient.status: type=status, session_id, schemaVersion, asr_available, asr_status, asr_modelPath, text_channel, sample_rate, full_duplex
serverToClient.turn_start: type=turn_start, text, reply, session_id, generation, barge_in
serverToClient.audio_end: type=audio_end, session_id, generation, first_chunk_latency_s, rtf, audio_duration_s, state
serverToClient.asr: type=asr, status, text, partial, available, reason, session_id
serverToClient.metrics: type=metrics, session_id, state, first_chunk_latency_s_avg, rtf_avg, audio_chunks, turns, barge_ins
serverToClient.error: type=error, error, optional detail, optional session_id, optional generation

base64JsonAlternative.pcm16le_base64: base64 string of raw PCM16LE bytes

format.chunkFrames: chunk_frames mel frames x hop_length 256 samples; default 8 => 2048 samples => 4096 bytes per full chunk

bargeInCancel.effect: increments generation and stops emitting audio chunks at the next chunk boundary

asr.commandSecurity: argv list, shell=False, bounded timeout, no secrets logged

names.first_chunk_latency_s: seconds from synthesis start to first emitted PCM chunk
names.backend: dsp | neural; dsp is deterministic fallback

consumerNotes.hy3d: Read /health first; open ws://host:port/ws; send text frames; consume binary opcode 0x2 PCM16LE; stop on audio_end; send barge_in/cancel to interrupt. If ASR is unavailable, use text frames as the authoritative transcript.
consumerNotes.stabilityEnforcement: scripts/validate-service-contract.py checks this file against server.py, wsproto.py, tts.py, web/index.html, demo.py, and README.md; it exits nonzero on drift.
